explanation: OEIS A113271 (a(n) = Σ_{i=0}^n 2^(i·2^(n−i)): 1, 3, 9, 41, 593, 135457, …): 'The smallest primes in this (always odd) sequence are a(1) = 3, a(3) = 41 and a(5) = 543. What is the next prime?' The listed 'a(5) = 543' is an evident typo: the DATA has a(4) = 593 (prime) and a(5) = 135457 = 7·37·523, and 543 = 3·181 is not prime. The formal statement therefore asks for the value of the next prime term after index 4, documenting the correction. I verified a(0..5) numerically. This is the evident intent, so severity 1.
